notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.24.1
Continuum Subtraction: WB Diagnostics opens tiled beside the Q Preview with a per-filter tab, a clipped scatter plot and the numbers that describe the fit — slope, star residual at Q=1, scatter, flux span, and where in the frame the stars came from. Detection sigma is automatic (a 200->3 waterfall against a star target you set), the noise floor is measured on your frame instead of fixed, and the fit now clips saturated stars, thins over-crowded regions and sigma-clips in slope space. Q opens at 1.00, the mathematically pure value. The workspace is now a pannable canvas: it grows at every edge, has its own scrollbars, Tile and Cascade bring it back, and the new Workspace Map dock shows the whole thing to scale with the visible part as a box you drag. SRGC reaches the southern sky — SHASSA Ha, the all-sky Finkbeiner Ha composite, VTSS, three NSNS colour trees and HI4PI as a cirrus template. Stacking Suite: a loud warning when your master dark is over-subtracting pixels to 0.0 (the no-data value, so they leave the stack entirely), per-filter star detection sigma so narrowband frames stop failing registration in mixed LRGB+SHO runs, and the Execution Monitor no longer goes blank mid-stack — plus a Monitor button to bring it back. See the release notes for the full list.
